text:
anita: FYI — PR #6543 needs 2x approvals before cutoff in ~30m. It's the kv-cache memfix, small change but high-risk. https://github.com/redwood-inference/pull/6543
sam: On it. I'll take a quick pass now. Can someone confirm tests are green?
jaya: CI passed earlier, but there's a flaky e2e we saw yesterday. I ran the matrix again ~10m ago and it was green.
tomas: @anita is the change scoped to the hotfix only? want to avoid touching rollout code.
anita: yes scoped — only touches cache key expiry logic. No rollout changes.
ryan: i'm the other approver on rotation but heads-up I'm on a call for 20m. If it's blocked after that, we should have a fallback.
sam: I left a tiny comment about a missing nil-check. If that's fixed and tests are green i'll give a +1.
anita: thanks. pushed a one-line fix.
jenkins-bot: build/6543 passed all checks — unit: ✅ integration: ✅ e2e: flaky? (2/3)
ryan: coming back in 12m, can we hold merge until i can click approve?
anita: we need 2x approvals before cutoff at 2172348978 (30m from now). If ryan can't approve before cutoff, options: 1) delay the release, 2) merge with emergency rollback plan, 3) cut a minimal revertable cherry-pick and push later. Thoughts?
tomas: prefer option 3 — produce a tiny rollout PR that can be rolled back quickly. Less blast radius.
sam: agree with tomas. We can add a quick feature-flag gate too. But that requires another tiny commit.
jaya: if we go 3, we still need 2 approvers for that new PR. That brings us back to the same problem.
ryan: if you can tag me on the new PR i'll prioritize approval as soon as I'm off this call.
anita: ok i'll open a constrained PR (6544) with the same fix but behind a feature flag and add notes on rollback. Tagging @ryan.
deploy-bot: Deploy cutoff in 30 minutes — scheduled window: 2172348978.
sam: re-reviewing 6543 now. looks good after nil-check. i'll approve 6543 to give you one approve. +1 from me.
ryan: i'm free — reviewing now.
tomas: i can be second approver if you want me to gate it.
anita: if ryan can approve 6543 now we have 2x and can merge before cutoff. Otherwise we'll go with the split PR approach.
ryan: gave +1. quick note: watch for mem pressure on node-7, but looks acceptable.
anita: merging now. command I'll run: 
```
gh pr merge 6543 --squash --delete-branch
```
sam: :thumbsup: please monitor logs for first 10 minutes after deploy.
deploy-bot: Merge recorded for PR 6543 by anita at 2172348123. Canary rollout started (5% of traffic).
jaya: watching logs. no obvious errors in canary.
tomas: i'll prep rollback script just in case: `git revert <commit>` and `gh deploy rollback canary` ready.
anita: thanks team. if anything weird ping #eng-oncall and i'll cut the revert.
ryan: closing loop — approved + watched the canary. All good from me.
anita: closing thread — merged and canary healthy at +10m.
